summary: Login bug-reproduction task: VERIFIED LOGIN WORKS END-TO-END FOR ALL 4 CREDENTIAL TIERS. Backend curl: POST /api/auth/login returns 200 + valid JWT for admin@k3gas.com (role=admin), hr@k3gas.com (role=hr_admin), jullang@k3gas.com (role=warehouse_manager, warehouse=Jullang), hollongi@k3gas.com (role=warehouse_manager, warehouse=Plant Hollongi). Wrong password returns 401 'Invalid credentials'. Non-existent email returns 401 'Invalid credentials' (NOT 500). JWT decoded payload has user_id/email/role/exp. Token accepted by admin-only endpoints: /api/gst/config (200), /api/gst/items (200), /api/gst/plans (200), /api/users (200), /api/warehouses (200). CORS preflight OPTIONS /api/auth/login returns 204 with access-control-allow-origin:* and POST/PUT/DELETE allowed methods. Frontend (https://unified-checkout-8.preview.emergentagent.com/login): page renders correctly, form data-testid=email-input + password input + button[type=submit] all present. Admin login: POST observed in network -> 200 -> redirected to /select-dashboard, k3gas_token + k3gas_user persisted in localStorage. HR login -> redirected to /hrms. Jullang manager -> /manager-dashboard with warehouse=Jullang. Hollongi plant manager -> /manager-dashboard with warehouse=Plant Hollongi. Wrong password -> stays on /login, no token stored, /api/auth/login returns 401. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env (https://unified-checkout-8.preview.emergentagent.com) matches the URL frontend is calling. CONCLUSION: No login regression. User-reported 'preview login error' is almost certainly stale browser cache/old preview URL on user side.
action_items: INFORM USER: Login is verified working for all 4 credential tiers (admin/hr/jullang/hollongi). Issue is almost certainly stale browser cache on the user's previous preview URL. Ask user to: (a) hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R / Cmd+Shift+R), (b) clear localStorage for the preview domain, (c) confirm they are using the current URL https://unified-checkout-8.preview.emergentagent.com (not an older preview URL from previous iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx uses sonner toast.success/toast.error for feedback - working as expected. The data-testid='login-error' inline error banner only renders when state.error is truthy; on wrong password it appears briefly and clears on next form interaction - this is acceptable UX.
Token stored under localStorage key 'k3gas_token' (not 'token') and user under 'k3gas_user' - any docs/test helpers must use these exact keys.

Phase A changes (gst_config, num2words, View Invoice dialog, Settings dialog tabs, print CSS, Receipt icon import) are confirmed isolated - they did NOT touch any auth code path. /api/auth/login flow is intact.

rca of the issue: User reported 'unable to preview login .. login error'. RCA: NO server-side or frontend defect reproducible on current build. Tested exhaustively: (a) 4/4 valid credential tiers succeed via curl AND via Playwright UI flow on the current REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; (b) Wrong password & non-existent email correctly return 401 (not 500); (c) JWT is valid and accepted by protected endpoints; (d) CORS headers correct; (e) Phase A code changes confirmed not to touch auth path. The most likely cause for the user's symptom is stale browser cache or use of an older preview URL. Mitigation: instruct user to hard-refresh, clear localStorage/cookies for the preview domain, and confirm they are using https://unified-checkout-8.preview.emergentagent.com (the current REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
